claims.claim: JCB Co., Ltd. was established in 1961, is headquartered in Minami Aoyama, Tokyo, and is chaired by Takayoshi Futae as Chairman & CEO.
claims.quote: Established January 25, 1961 Capital 10.6 billion yen (as of June 2026) Chairman & CEO Takayoshi Futae
claims.title: Corporate Overview | JCB Global Website
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Head Office: Aoyama Rise Square 5-1-22 Minami Aoyama, Minato-ku, Tokyo 107-8686. Employees 4,472 (as of March 2026).

claims.claim: JCB is privately held; major shareholders listed as of July 2026 are the employee shareholding association, MUFG Bank, Taiyo Life, SMBC, Toyota Financial Services, ORIX and TISI; no ownership change since 2020 is stated.
claims.quote: JCB Employee Shareholding Association, MUFG Bank, Ltd., Taiyo Life Insurance Company, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, Toyota Financial Services Corporation, ORIX Corporation, TISI Inc., etc.
claims.title: Corporate Overview | JCB Global Website
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: No filings equivalent to a 10-K; JCB is not listed. Overseas affiliates include JCB International Co., Ltd. and regional entities in Asia, Oceania, Europe, Eurasia and Middle East (as of June 2026).

claims.claim: JCB reports FY2025 (April 2025 to March 2026) annual transaction volume of 53.4 trillion yen, including other payment-related products and estimates.
claims.quote: Annual Transaction Volume ¥53.4 trillion * Includes other payment related products and estimates. (FY 2025 (April 2025 through March 2026))
claims.title: Corporate Overview | JCB Global Website
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: FY2025 net revenue 466.2 billion yen; operating profit 49.4 billion yen; net income 29.7 billion yen. Transaction counts are not published on this page.

claims.claim: JCB reports 181.9 million cardmembers and about 72 million merchants as of March 2026, both including estimates or other payment-related products.
claims.quote: Cardmembers 181.9 million * Includes other payment related products. (as of March 2026) Merchants About 72 million * Includes estimates. (as of March 2026)
claims.title: Corporate Overview | JCB Global Website
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: The May 2026 Discover release boilerplate says 'about 72 million merchants' and 'more than 181 million cardmembers', consistent with this page. Country count and ATM count not published on pages read.

claims.claim: JCB has held reciprocal acceptance arrangements with Discover Network since 2006 (Discover cards on JCB's Japan network; JCB cards on Discover Network in the US), and the two marked 20 years in May 2026.
claims.quote: Since 2006, the companies have maintained reciprocal acceptance arrangements that enable Discover cardholders to use their cards across JCB's acceptance network in Japan
claims.title: JCB and Discover(R) Network Mark 20 Years of Collaboration
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Post-dates Capital One's May 18, 2025 acquisition of Discover; the release names Jason Hanson as President, Discover Network and describes Discover with Diners Club International and PULSE as accepted in more than 185 countries and territories. The release does not mention Capital One.

claims.claim: JCB's merchant site states reciprocal relationships with American Express International for Australia, New Zealand and Canada, and with Discover Network for the US.
claims.quote: reciprocal relationships with other major international payment brands
claims.title: Merchants | JCB Global Website
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Page names American Express International, Inc. (Australia, New Zealand, Canada) and Discover Network (U.S.) as the partners.

claims.claim: JCB describes itself as having alliances with hundreds of banks and financial institutions globally, with cards issued mainly in Asian countries and territories.
claims.quote: JCB has formed alliances with hundreds of leading banks and financial institutions globally to increase its merchant coverage and cardmember base.
claims.title: JCB and Discover(R) Network Mark 20 Years of Collaboration
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Exact issuer or acquirer participant counts are not published.

claims.claim: JCB's partner-facing business lines are Card Issuing and Merchant Acquiring, with security and payment-solution products; the acquiring page positions JCB as seeking partners to sign merchants.
claims.quote: We are seeking best partners to connect JCB to potential JCB member stores.
claims.title: Businesses | JCB Global Website
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Card Issuing page: 'We help your Businesses to improve customer experiences better with our powerful support service.' No product catalogue, licence types or fees are published on either page.

claims.claim: JCB's published security catalogue comprises J/Secure (3-D Secure authentication), J/Smart (EMV chip application for issuers), PCI DSS, the JCB Data Security Program, IC cards, IC terminals and the holographic magnetic stripe.
claims.quote: JCB developed the J/Smart™ EMV compliant chip card application for our issuing partners worldwide.
claims.title: Security | JCB Global Website
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Payment-solution catalogue: Tap to Pay on iPhone, JCB Contactless, QUICPay (Japan). No gateway, dispute, data or loyalty products are listed for partners on the global site.

claims.claim: J/Secure 2.0 is JCB's EMV 3DS-style risk-based authentication programme; JCB publishes the spec download, a compliant-operator list and an Operator Compliance Program for issuers, acquirers and vendors.
claims.quote: For JCB Card Issuers, Acquirers and Vendors Download J/Secure™2.0 Specifications J/Secure™ Compliant Operator List Download J/Secure™ Logo J/Secure™ Operator Compliance Program
claims.title: J/Secure™ | JCB Global Website
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Page says J/Secure has protected cardmembers since 2004; a merchant FAQ is also linked.

claims.claim: JCB launched a card-on-file network tokenisation service in May 2025 with Adyen as first implementer, and plans to roll COF tokens out globally.
claims.quote: JCB's COF tokenization service replaces the JCB-branded COF data with an anonymized secure number (hereinafter "network token").
claims.title: Adyen and JCB launch Card-on-File Tokenization to Enhance Payment Security
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Tac Watanabe, Executive Officer and Head of Brand Infrastructure Headquarters, quoted: 'we plan to actively implement COF tokens globally.'

claims.claim: JCB Partner Online is the gated partner portal (Salesforce Sites login) where business partners download specifications and request promotional materials and monthly reports.
claims.quote: By logging into and accessing the site, partners can download various specifications documents, and request applications for promotional materials, monthly reports, and more.
claims.title: Businesses | JCB Global Website
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Login URL https://jcb-partner-online.my.salesforce-sites.com/login. Not readable without an account. No public developer centre, status page, community or bulletin archive is exposed on global.jcb.

claims.claim: JCB's press listing is served from a JSON feed (news_file.json) rendered client-side, with categories ALLIANCE, PRODUCTS & TECHNOLOGIES, SERVICES & PROMOTIONS and OTHER.
claims.title: newslist.js
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Release pages live at /en/press/{year}/{fileName}. Year pages redirect to /en/press/index.html?year=YYYY and are empty without JavaScript.

claims.claim: The JCB Data Security Program requires Licensees, TPPs, IPSPs and merchants with access to cardmember data to comply with PCI DSS, with e-commerce/MOTO/TPP compliance mandatory from April 1, 2018 and attended transactions from April 1, 2020.
claims.quote: JCB requires Licensees to ensure that the Licensees themselves, TPPs, IPSPs and Merchants with access to cardmember data and transaction data comply with the JCB Data Security Program.
claims.title: JCB Data Security Program | JCB Global Website
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Validation tiers: merchants with one million or more JCB transactions per year require quarterly scans and yearly on-site review; under one million require yearly SAQ and quarterly scans; acquirers and issuers mandatory regardless of volume. Local law prevails over the programme.

claims.claim: JCB's public merchant requirements prohibit gambling, adult telephone/chat services and locally illegal goods, require consultation for health products, price-volatile commodities and customs-restricted cosmetics/drugs, and mandate encryption.
claims.quote: Merchants must use SSL or other industry-recognized encryption and firewalls
claims.title: Merchant Requirements | JCB Global Website
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: No public rulebook, chargeback/dispute framework, bulletin cadence or interchange schedule is published on the global site; operating regulations are behind JCB Partner Online.

claims.claim: JCB's global site publishes no membership types, application steps, certification stages, timelines or fees for issuers or acquirers; the only routes given are the Contact page and JCB Partner Online for existing partners.
claims.quote: JCB Partner Online is a dedicated site for our business partners.
claims.title: Card Issuing | JCB Global Website
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Absence finding. Data Security Program page implies licence terminology ('Licensees', 'TPPs', 'IPSPs') but no licence classes are described publicly.

claims.claim: Partner-relevant JCB releases Sep 2024 to Sep 2026 include acquiring launches with Azer Turk Bank (Sep 2024) and Arab Bank Jordan (May 2025), Adyen COF tokenisation (May 2025), the Discover 20-year milestone (May 2026), a MUFG ASEAN alliance MOU (Jul 2026), a Circle stablecoin MOU (Jul 2026) and a Fiuu SEA acceptance deal (Jul 2026).
claims.quote: JCB and Discover(R) Network Mark 20 Years of Collaboration
claims.title: JCB press feed (news_file.json)
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Other dated titles in feed: 2024-10-08 Nuvei APAC expansion; 2024-10-21 GHL Malaysia/Thailand/Philippines; 2025-01-16 DOJO UK; 2025-03-18 First Cash Solution Germany; 2025-05-27 PayXpert Europe/UK; 2025-10-27 STC Bank acceptance; 2025-11-07 18th JCB World Conference, Incheon; 2026-03-04 Resona UWB payments; 2026-08-19 Digital Garage stablecoin PoC at Lawson; 2026-09-03 Nexi Campania transit; 2026-09-08 Sleeping Giant Media Europe. Only titles were read for these; bodies not fetched.

claims.claim: JCB holds a periodic partner event, the JCB World Conference, whose 18th edition took place in Incheon, Republic of Korea in November 2025.
claims.quote: The 18th JCB World Conference Held in Incheon, Republic of Korea
claims.title: JCB press feed (news_file.json)
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Title only; release body not fetched. No client-service hours, SLAs, languages or training academy are published on the global site.

claims.claim: In the May 2026 milestone release JCB and Discover Network said they will explore streamlining processes and reducing operational complexity for existing and prospective partners across both networks.
claims.quote: the companies will explore opportunities to streamline processes and reduce operational complexity, aiming to create an environment where existing and prospective partners worldwide
claims.title: JCB and Discover(R) Network Mark 20 Years of Collaboration
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Forward-looking statement with no named programme or date.
